headline: Georgian Court win on the road, stand alone unbeaten
dek: Georgian Court have now won twice and drawn twice, scoring twelve goals and conceding six, and the second win came on the road at Pitt-Johnstown after two away draws. Bridgeport, unbeaten alongside them a day earlier, lost at home to Mercy, and every other programme in the CACC had already been beaten.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Georgian Court's twelve goals have come from seven different scorers, and Sander Rynning has three of them. The tallest bar is a spread of contributions rather than one player's tally.

wire.line: Bridgeport's run ended at home to Mercy, leaving Georgian Court as the only side in the conference still unbeaten.
